atoms.sound: Bei der Umwandlung in die indirekte Rede müssen neben der Zeitverschiebung weitere Anpassungen vorgenommen werden. Diese Anpassungen betreffen die Personal- und Possessivpronomen, sowie die Ort- und Zeitangaben.

instruction.text: Lies den Satz und forme ihn anschließend in die indirekte Rede um, indem du das passende Satzende auswählst.

atoms.sound: Evelyn said that she was a vegetarian.

atoms.b: Benjamin said, “I love my new shoes.”

atoms.b: Matteo said to me, “You should join us after school.”

atoms.sound: Matteo said that I should join them after school.

instruction.text: Lies den Satz und forme ihn anschließend in die indirekte Rede um, indem du das passende Satzende auswählst.

atoms.b: Irem said, “We will go to Hamburg by train.”

atoms.sound: Irem said that they would go to Hamburg by train.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du die richtige Zeitangabe auswählst.

atoms.a: Abigail said, “I read a newspaper article on air pollution in big cities today.”
atoms.b: Abigail said that she read a newspaper article on air pollution in big cities ((++that_day the_next_day the_day_before)).

atoms.a: Akio said, “My grandparents will visit us next week.”
atoms.b: Akio said that his grandparents would visit them ((++the_following_week the_week_before that_week))

atoms.a: Freya said, “I went to a concert last month.”
atoms.b: Freya said that she had gone to a concert ((++the_month_before the_following_month that_month)).

atoms.a: Mikail said, “I finished reading the book three days ago.”
atoms.b: Mikail said that he had finished reading the book ((++three_days_earlier in_the_next_three_days that_day)).
